raw:
SELECT T2.name, SUM(t.tip_amount) AS total_tip_amount 
FROM trips t 
JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id 
JOIN payment_types pt ON t.payment_type = pt.payment_type_id 
WHERE pz.borough = 'Brooklyn' 
GROUP BY T2.name 
ORDER BY total_tip_amount DESC 
LIMIT 3
sql:
SELECT T2.name, SUM(t.tip_amount) AS total_tip_amount 
FROM trips t 
JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id 
JOIN payment_types pt ON t.payment_type = pt.payment_type_id 
WHERE pz.borough = 'Brooklyn' 
GROUP BY T2.name 
ORDER BY total_tip_amount DESC 
LIMIT 3
